target: 577 Eadem Cogitationes

source: 577 Same Thoughts
target: 577 Eadem Cogitationes

source: On the flower ship, Lato Guiaro extended his arms, and sunlight erupted from his body.
target: In nave florum, Lato Guiaro brachia extendit, et claritas solis ex corpore eius erupit.

source: The sky dimmed, and the sea approached nothingness.
target: Caelum obscuratum est, et mare ad nihilum appropinquavit.

source: Illusory stars emerged among them, expanding like distant suns.
target: Stellae illusoriae inter eos apparuerunt, dilatantes quasi soli remoti.

source: In the next moment, Lato Guiaro swiftly spoke a few words in ancient Hermes with a grave expression, “God says entering dreams is ineffective!”
target: Mox, in momento sequenti, Lato Guiaro celeriter pauca verba in antiqua lingua Hermes, vultu gravissimo edecit: “Deus dicit in somnia ingredi inefficax esse!”

source: With the reinforcement of the sea’s power, he neared the status of a Sequence 4 demigod.
target: Auxilio potentiae maris confirmato, ad statum semidei ordinis IV appropinquavit.

source: This allowed him to employ the Notary’s “God says” ability more precisely, diminishing Hela’s capacity to compel people into entering dreams.
target: Hoc ei concessit ut facultatem notarii “Deus dicit” accuratius adhiberet, minuens vim Helae coegendi homines in somnia ingredi.

source: Without this intervention, if Hela used her ability to forcefully restrain him without guiding him into an easily interruptible dream to gather information, breaking free from such a demigod’s dream would prove challenging in a short time.
target: Sine hac interventione, si Hela facultate sua eum vi cohibere conatus esset, sine eum in somnium facile interpellabile ad informationes colligendas ducendo, ex tali semidei somnio evadere breviter arduum foret.

source: He would become like a feral dog under anesthesia, at Lumian Lee’s mercy.
target: Fieret ut canis ferus sub sopore, ad misericordiam Lumian Lee.

source: The choice of “entering dreams is ineffective” over “sleeping is ineffective” was deliberate.
target: Electio “in somnia ingredi inefficax est” potius quam “dormire inefficax est” deliberata fuit.

source: The former was more specific and avoided potential ambiguity related to various abilities.
target: Primum specificius fuit et ambiguitatem potentialem, quae ad varias facultates pertinebat, vitavit.

source: Additionally, the Evernight pathway’s induced slumber originated from being forcefully drawn into a dream, not the other way around.
target: Praeterea, sopor inducitus per viam Evernight ex vi coacta in somnium ducendo oriebatur, non ex contraria causa.

source: Essentially, it was a dream, not sleep.
target: Essentialiter, somnium erat, non somnus.

source: As Lato Guiaro pronounced the ancient Hermes phrase “entering dreams is ineffective,” his body still felt as weighty as the humanoid Sealed Artifact, though not as exaggerated.
target: Dum Lato Guiaro pronuntiavit antiquam sententiam Hermeticam “in somnia ingredi inefficax est,” corpus eius adhuc tam grave videbatur quam hominiforme Artifactum Sigillatum, quamquam non tam ostentatum.

source: This stirred massive waves in the surrounding seawater, attempting to fill the void.
target: Hoc movit fluctus ingentes in aquis circumjacentes, vacuitatem implere conantes.

source: The sailboat manipulated by the undead creatures visibly swayed, nearly capsizing, severely impeding Hela’s further movements.
target: Navis, a creaturis ex mortuis revivificatis tractata, conspicuē oscillabat, paene corruens, motus ulteriora Helae graviter impediens.

source: Immediately after, Lato Guiaro reclined even further.
target: Immediate post, Lato Guiaro se amplius reclinavit.

source: A miniature, bright sun manifested in his eyes.
target: Parvus et clarus sol in oculis eius apparuit.

source: Simultaneously, the ethereal sky and the stars emerging from the sea emitted light of varying intensities.
target: Simul, caelum aetherium et stellae ex mari emergentes lucem diversarum intensitatum emiserunt.

source: They interweaved, crafting a splendid and pure blazing pillar of light.
target: Se intertexuerunt, columen lucis splendidum et purum ardens conficientes.

source: The majestic pillar of light descended, enveloping the front half of the sailboat, where Hela stood.
target: Columna lucis magnifica descendit, involvens dimidiam partem anterior navis, ubi Hela stabat.

source: It melted the undead creatures there as if they had evaporated, leaving no trace of darkness.
target: Illos creaturas ex mortuis revivificatas illic liquavit, quasi evanuerint, relicta nulla vestigia obscuritatis.

source: Hela became engulfed by the pillar of light.
target: Hela columnae lucis absorpta est.

source: This was the Light of Holiness, an ability of a Sequence 5 Priest of the Light of the Sun pathway.
target: Haec erat Lux Sanctitatis, facultas Sacerdotis Sequentiae V viae Lucis Solis.

source: Despite not consuming a corresponding Sequence 4 potion and lacking demigod-level abilities after becoming the temporary Governor of the Sea, Lato Guiaro could elevate his acquired abilities to near Sequence 4.
target: Quamquam poculum Sequentiae IV idoneum non consumpsit et facultates semideae non obtinuit postquam Provectus Maris temporarius factus est, Lato Guiaro facultates suas adeptas prope Sequentiam IV elevare poterat.

source: Moreover, the Light of Holiness had undergone a mutation.
target: Insuper, Lux Sanctitatis mutationem subiit.

source: It no longer emanated from a single sun.
target: Non iam ex uno sol emanabat.

source: All the stars in the Cosmic Void contributed to its power.
target: Omnes stellae in Vacuo Cosmico vim eius addiderunt.

source: Coupled with the uniqueness of these waters, while not as potent as the Sequence 4 Flaring Sun of this pathway in purifying and destroying impure entities, its attack range and area of influence had significantly expanded.
target: Coniuncta singularitate harum aquarum, etsi non ita potentia ut Solis Flagrantis Sequens IV huius viae in purgando et interficendo entia immunda, radius impetuum eius et spatium influentiae signanter extensum est.

source: Having transmigrated into a Child of the Sea and possessing substantial boons, Lato Guiaro had carefully considered the Sun pathway potion, believing it posed no risks and might integrate with his bloodline and original abilities, bringing about remarkable changes.
target: Transmigratus in Filium Maris et dotibus significativis praeditus, Lato Guiaro poculum viae Solis diligenter consideravit, creditque id nullum periculum esse et cum stirpe sanguinis eius et facultatibus originalibus integre coniungi posse, mutationes mirabiles ferens.

source: The outcome aligned with his expectations.
target: Eventus secundum exspectationem eius evenit.

source: Suddenly, Lato Guiaro pivoted.
target: Subito, Lato Guiaro se convertit.

source: In the space behind him, Lumian’s figure swiftly materialized.
target: In spatio post eum, figura Lumiani celeriter apparuit.

source: He intended to exploit Lato Guiaro’s engagement with Hela to “teleport” closer, followed by a Spell of Harrumph.
target: Intendebat Lato Guiaro implicatum cum Hela ad propius teleporterandum, subsequente incantatione “Harrumph” uti.

source: Gone from his eyes was any suppressed violence or madness.
target: Ab oculis eius omnis violentia repressa et insania evanuerant.

source: There was no fear whatsoever, as if he didn’t concern himself with the consequences of failing to assail the Governor of the Sea at close range.
target: Nullus timor erat, quasi non curaret de consequentiis, si prope Gubernatorem Maris oppugnare deficeret.

source: In Lato Guiaro’s dark and profound eyes, resplendent stars reflected.
target: In oculis obscuris et profundis Lato Guiaro stellae splendidæ reflexæ sunt.

source: Before Lumian could utter the harrumph, he plunged into the void, disappearing beneath the vast and distant cosmos.
target: Antequam Lumian “Harrumph” edicere posset, in vacuum se immergit, sub vasto et remotissimo cosmo evanescens.

source: Lato Guiaro withdrew his gaze and focused on the sailboat illuminated by the residual light.
target: Lato Guiaro conspectum aversit et in navem vela luce residua illustratam intuebatur.

source: He found an adversary like Lumian Lee repulsive.
target: Inimicum, simile Lumian Lee, ei repulsivum videbatur.

source: It wasn’t that he couldn’t be forcibly eliminated, but doing so might only exacerbate matters.
target: Non quia vi tolli non posset, sed id tantum res aggravare poterat.

source: He could potentially incur the indiscriminate wrath of a high‐ranking individual.
target: Potest incurrere in iram indiscriminatam ab aliquo summo.

source: His decision was to leverage the authority of the Governor of the Sea to banish his foe into a self‐created Cosmic Void, leaving him disoriented and unable to find an exit for the time being.
target: Decisio eius fuit auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris adhibere ut hostem suum in Vacuo Cosmico ipso creato desterneret, relinquens eum confusum et exitu temporario inhibitum.

source: Once he assumed control of the spaceship and became the true Governor of the Sea, he planned to return and calmly resolve the issue.
target: Postquam gubernationem navis spatialis asumpsit et verus Gubernator Maris factus est, redire atque quaestionem placide solvere destinavit.

source: At that precise moment, Juan Oro, entangled in a battle with the humanoid Sealed Artifact in his Cosmic Void, suddenly detected an anomaly.
target: Illo momento, Juan Oro, in pugna cum Artifacto Sigillato hominiformi in suo Vacuo Cosmico implicatus, subito anomaliam detexit.

source: His strength rapidly waned, and his dominion over the sea gradually diminished!
target: Virtus eius celeriter defuit, et dominium eius super mare paulatim decrevit!

source: It seemed like his temporary authority as Governor of the Sea was being usurped.
target: Videbatur quod auctoritas eius temporaria ut Gubernator Maris subripienda esset.

source: In the blink of an eye, the tidal wave capable of shattering ships vanished from the Cosmic Void, followed by the illusory cosmos itself.
target: In momento, unda aestuosa, quae naves frangere posset, de Vacuo Cosmico evanuit, secuta ipsa cosmos illusorium.

source: Juan Oro “reappeared” on the ship once more and “saw” the azure sea around him, towering like a mountain peak.
target: Juan Oro in nave iterum “reapparuit” et “vidit” mare azureum circum eum, eminens sicut culmen montis.

source: He “saw” Simon Guiaro, closely linked to the sea.
target: Vidit Simon Guiaro, ad mare intime conexum.

source: “It’s you!” His roar coincided with an involuntary bend, as if an invisible force pressed him down to the floor.
target: “Tu es!” clamor eius coincidebat cum involuntaria flexione, quasi vis invisibilis eum ad terram deprimendum fuisset.

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact had also returned, reinstating a formidable weight.
target: Artifactum Sigillatum hominiforme etiam rediit, pondus formidabile restituens.

source: Lato Guiaro gazed at her, his face covered in scales tinged with starlight.
target: Lato Guiaro eam aspexit; facies ejus squamis micantibus, luce stellarum tinctis operta erat.

source: Then, he pointed at Hela’s ship and spoke in a fluent language, “¥%…&”
target: Deinde, ad navem Helae digitavit et lingua facili locutus est: “¥%…&”

source: He didn’t comprehend the exact meaning of the sentence, but he understood that it could prompt the other party to attack a designated target.
target: Non exacte intellexit sensum sententiae, sed animadvertit eam posse aliam partem ad certum propositum oppugnandum impellere.

source: Although he harbored no fear of Hela in these waters, he remained vigilant of Gandalf and others who might be on the ship.
target: Quamquam in his aquis nullus timor adversus Helam ferebatur, tamen de Gandalf aliisque, qui in nave esse poterent, vigilabat.

source: Therefore, he had to give his utmost effort.
target: Ergo, summam conationem dare debuit.

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact’s sorrow dissipated slightly, and it nodded blankly.
target: Dolor Artifacti Sigillati hominiformis paulum evanuit, et caput vacue annuit.

source: Her body pivoted towards the sailboat, which bobbed in the “underwater waves.”
target: Corpus eius se convertit ad navem vela, quae in undis subaquaneis fluctuabat.

source: In an instant, Lato Guiaro bent down and grasped his throat.
target: In instante, Lato Guiaro se inclinavit et collum suum apprehendit.

source: Waa!
target: Waa!

source: He ejected a slender, sticky blob of flesh.
target: Eiecit tenuem, viscosam globulam carnis.

source: The flesh contorted and writhed, swiftly taking on a human form.
target: Caro contorta et flexa est, celeriter formam humanam assumens.

source: Lato Guiaro promptly straightened up and seized the moment to command,
target: Lato Guiaro citissime se erexit et occasionem ceperit ut praeceptum daret,

source: “Mad Lady, open the passageway to the spaceship!”
target: “Domina Insana, aperi iter ad navem spatiale!”

source: He wasn’t concerned that Mad Lady might usurp the position of the Governor of the Sea and become the owner of the spaceship because she lacked the sea bloodline.
target: Non curabat ne Domina Insana Gubernatoris Maris locum subligere conaretur atque navem spatiale possideret, quoniam stirpis maris ei deesset.

source: In the Cosmic Void crafted by Lato Guiaro, Lumian showed no urgency to find an exit or ascertain his coordinates.
target: In Vacuo Cosmico Lato Guiaro creato, Lumian nullam festinationem exitum quaerendi aut suae positionis cognoscendi demonstravit.

source: He simply “teleported” out.
target: Simpliciter “teleportavit” foras.

source: He clasped his throat.
target: Collum suum tenuit.

source: Waa!
target: Waa!

source: He ejected a slender, sticky blob of flesh.
target: Eiecit tenuem, viscosam globulam carnis.

source: The flesh contorted and writhed, swiftly taking on a human form.
target: Caro contorta et flexa est, celeriter formam humanam assumens.

source: Solow Motel, adjacent to Lumian’s suite.
target: Solow Motel, iuxta conclave Lumiani.

source: Recalling that Invisibility and Shadow Concealment were futile against Marionettists, Jenna pondered ways to locate Loki’s true form.
target: Meminens quod Invisibilitas et Occultatio Umbrae contra Marionettistas vanae erant, Jenna de modis inveniendae verae formae Loki meditata est.

source: Drawing on information from the Major Arcana card holders, she knew a Marionettist had to be within five meters of a target to transform individuals into marionettes.
target: Ex informationibus ab tenentibus chartarum Major Arcana receptis, scivit Marionettistam esse intra radium quinquem metrorum circa cuiusdam scopum, ut singulos in marionettas converteret.

source: In other words, Loki was undoubtedly within a five-meter radius of Lugano.
target: Id est, Loki scilicet intra radium quinquem metrorum Lugani versabatur.

source: Dammit, it’s all walls. My sight is blocked.
target: Maledictum, omnes parietes sunt. Conspectus meus obstructus est.

source: Otherwise, spotting Loki would be easier.
target: Alio modo, Loki detegere facilius esset.

source: At this hour, most guests are away, celebrating the sea prayer ritual…
target: Hoc tempore, plerique hospites absunt, ritualem orationis maris celebrantes…

source: Walls… If there are no walls…
target: Muri… Si muri non sint…

source: An idea struck Jenna.
target: Idea Jenna occurvit.

source: She glanced at Anthony and blurted out, “Did you bring enough money?”
target: Illa oculos ad Anthonym intendens, subito exclamavit: “Attulistine satis pecuniae?”

source: “What money?” In a rare instance, Anthony couldn’t decipher Jenna’s true thoughts.
target: “Quae pecunia?” In raro casu, Anthony cogitationes Jennae recte discernere non potuit.

source: Only then did Jenna realize her words had been too abrupt.
target: Tum Jenna intellexit verba sua nimis subito esse.

source: “Money to compensate the motel owner.
target: “Pecunia est ad compensandum possessorem motel.

source: “I plan to blow up the opposite side, diagonally opposite, and the rooms below.
target: “Cogito partem adversam, diagonaliter oppositam, et cubicula inferiora explodere.

source: We confirmed they’re empty.
target: Confirmavimus ea esse vacua.

source: If anyone’s there, it’s Loki or his marionette!
target: Si quis adsit, est Loki aut eius Marionetta!

source: “I’ll place the detonators here.
target: “Hic detonatores ponebo.

source: They affect rooms within a seven-meter radius.
target: Eos cubicula intra radium septem metrorum attingunt.

source: Lugano will likely be injured, but with the lady as a shield and being a Doctor, he can handle it.
target: Probabile est Lugano laesum iri, sed cum Domina ut scutum fungatur et medicus sit, id tractare poterit.

source: “Right, the explosion will attract the Fertility Order’s combat nuns!”
target: “Ita, explosio moniales pugnantes Ordinis Fertilitatis alliciet!”

source: Jenna’s train of thought gradually flowed smoothly as she spoke.
target: Cogitatio Jennae leniter et paulatim fluxit dum loquebatur.

source: Are you a Hunter or a Demoness? Have you been influenced by Lumian…
target: “Venator esne aut Daemona? A Lumianone influentia passa es?”

source: Anthony mused inwardly. “Do it. Time is running out. Lumian will cover the compensation; he’s loaded.”
target: Anthony intime cogitavit: “Fac hoc. Tempus fugit. Lumian compensationes solvet; dives est.”

source: Jenna hurriedly searched her backpack for detonators.
target: Jenna celeriter tergo suo quaesivit detonatores.

source: Simultaneously, she noticed Anthony setting up a simple altar.
target: Simul, illa animadvertit Anthonyum altare simplex praeparare.

source: Her heart stirred as she asked, “Do you wish to contact Madam Justice, Madam Judgment, or Madam Magician?”
target: Cor eius commovit, dum interrogavit: “Visne contingere Dominam Justitiam, Dominam Iudicium, aut Dominam Magicam?”

source: “Either one works,” Anthony said seriously as he prepared for the ritual.
target: “Utraque operatur,” ait Anthony graviter, dum ad ritum praeparabatur.

source: “Although Madam Magician won’t appear until the end to prevent Loki and his backer from noticing, she mentioned that at least two Major Arcana cards will arrive early and provide assistance at critical moments.”
target: “Quamquam Domina Magica usque ad finem non apparebit, ne Loki et fautor eius animadverterent, dixit saltem duas chartas Major Arcana mane venturas esse et in momentis criticis auxilium feriturum.”

source: “Got it.” Jenna had been uncertain about when to reach out for help and inform their Major Arcana cardholders, so she had been contemplating handling it herself.
target: “Intellectum.” Jenna incerta erat de tempore auxilium petendi et informandi tenentes chartas Major Arcana, itaque ipsa hoc tractare cogitavit.

source: Given Anthony’s readiness to risk the disapproval of the Major Arcana cardholders, Jenna was naturally inclined to opt for the safest choice.
target: Cum Anthony praeparatus esset ad periculum disapprobationis tenentium chartarum Major Arcana, Jenna proprie ad optionem tutissimam inclinata est.

source: As Jenna stacked the detonators and other explosives near the adjacent door, Anthony Reid erected a spiritual barrier and summoned Madam Magician’s messenger, briefing her on Loki’s appearance.
target: Dum Jenna detonatores et alias explosive res iuxta ianuam adiacentem congregavit, Anthony Reid barriera spiritualis erexit et nuntium Dominae Magicæ convocavit, de aspectu Loki enarrans.

source: Then, he swiftly took cover in the bathroom attached to the master bedroom, about six to seven meters away from the impending explosion.
target: Deinde celerrime in balneo ad cubiculum principale adfixo abscondit, circiter sex ad septem metra a imminente explosione distantem.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: A fierce explosion tore through the fifth floor of Sauron Motel.
target: Explosio ferox per quintum tabulatum Sauron Motel irrupit.

source: Glass shattered, debris scattered, and crimson flames engulfed the surroundings.
target: Vitrum confractum est, ruinae sparsae sunt, et flammae rubrae omnia circumiecora devoraverunt.
